description: Remote control for a Google Flow server running in a GitHub Codespace. Observation and remote-control only: it sends jobs to your own server, which does the clicking in headed Chrome. It never touches flow.google.com directly, never submits anything to Flow itself, and never stores any Google session. Primary UI is the in-page panel on flow.google.com (Orion iOS); the popup is kept as the desktop fallback.
name: Flow Remote
